text:
Alex: CI alert — eval-runner started producing large diffs after the quantization pass. Scorecard drilldown shows duplicated sample ids and token-metric mismatches. Anyone seen this?

ci-bot: CI failed: eval-runner-quant-ci #452 — job exited 1. Logs: `runner-exec: exit code 1` (see /ci/artifacts/452/runner.log) :warning:

Miriam: hm, does this reproduce locally? alex can you paste the failing command so I can try? :eyes:

Alex: repro command from CI:```bash
RUNIT=runner_quant pytest tests/eval_runner/test_quantized.py::test_quant_roundtrip -k kv_cache --maxfail=1 -q
# runner flags: --quantize=8bit --batch-accel --kv-cache-enabled
```

Sam: ran that locally — fails only when `--batch-accel` is set AND `--kv-cache-enabled=true`. If I remove batching the diffs disappear. Seems like batching + cached prefixes + quantized kernels = nondeterministic state. :bug:

Tyler: FYI the console drilldown does a naive join on sample_id + variant. If the runner emits two cache entries for the same sample tick the UI can show duplicate rows. Could be UI exposure of the runner duplication rather than a visualization math bug. I'll open a dashboard ticket.

Irina: double-check the metric aggregator too — our token-level metric (token-weighted BLEU-ish) currently uses a plain mean across tokens in some codepaths. If a sample is duplicated or partial it skews the average. We should switch to weighted mean by token count. I'll draft a small change.

Alex: Plan: (1) Tyler files UI bug for drilldown duplicates and link here; (2) Sam / I will add a CI testcase toggling `--batch-accel` + quant flags to reproduce in CI; (3) Irina will change the metric aggregator to weighted token averages; (4) add runner debug flag `--kv-debug` to capture cache ops in logs.

Miriam: I'll assemble a minimal repro and drop a patch in #ci. Quick repro snippet to share with the team:```bash
# run minimal eval locally
python -m eval_runner.runner 
  --model ./models/quant_v2/ 
  --data tests/fixtures/small_corpus.jsonl 
  --kv-cache-enabled 
  --batch-accel 
  --log-level debug > kv_debug.out
```
Look for repeated `kv_cache:store` entries with same key within the same tick.

Sam: small follow-up — I noticed the runtime emits `kv_cache:store(key=0xabc, tick=123)` twice when quantizer falls back and retries a kernel path. My branch fixes a dedupe in the cache writer. PR #1123 has the change and a unit test. Might be safe to backport this to the oncall branch.

Alex: Good catch. @Tyler please tag PRs with `ui:drilldown` and `infra:kv-cache` labels and link them here. Once Sam's fix merges, we'll re-run the CI job. :thumbsup:

jira-bot: Created ticket INF-987: eval-runner kv-cache duplicate entries -> dashboard duplicate rows (linked issues: PR #1123, dashboard/issue-791).

Tyler: opened dashboard/issue-791, added screenshots of duplicate rows and the query used in the drilldown. Putting a hotfix branch that dedupes by `sample_id|tick` while we confirm root cause.

Miriam: I'll queue the CI job with `RUST_LOG=debug` and `--kv-debug` so we have detailed logs. Dropping the job id in #ci when it's up.

Alex: Thanks all — keeping this thread as the canonical trail for the incident. If anyone finds a quick repro that doesn't require quantized kernels, ping here and I'll prioritize a rollback for the oncall lane. :white_check_mark:
